jobs.title: Proposal & Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
Responding to RFPs is a critical aspect of Assurant’s business, and the proposal coordinator plays a critical role managing RFP intake, as well as response authoring, revision, completion and delivery.
Key Objectives
- Increase win rate by developing and executing clear, client-focused win strategies for every RFP.
- Ensure on-time, high-quality submissions that are fully compliant and tailored to client requirements.
- Strengthen competitive differentiation by delivering compelling, insight-led proposals that clearly articulate Assurant’s value proposition.
- Drive cross-functional accountability by aligning stakeholders to defined roles, deadlines, and deliverables.
- Improve proposal efficiency and cycle time through standardized processes, tools, and best practices.
- Enhance content quality and consistency by managing reusable assets and ensuring messaging alignment across responses.
- Embed governance and performance tracking using KPIs (e.g., win rate, turnaround time, quality scores) to continuously improve outcomes.
- Increase stakeholder engagement and effectiveness through structured collaboration, clear communication, and proactive issue resolution.
- Identify and implement process improvements to scale the proposal function and support business growth.

Primary Job Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

30% Win Strategy & Proposal Leadership
- Own the development and execution of RFP win plans, ensuring each response is aligned to client priorities, competitive positioning, and Assurant’s strategic objectives.
- Translate complex requirements into clear, compelling, and differentiated narratives that increase probability of win.
- Challenge and guide stakeholders to ensure contributions are strategic, relevant, and aligned to the overall value proposition.

30% End-to-End RFP Ownership
- Lead the full lifecycle of RFP responses—from intake qualification through to final submission—with clear accountability for quality, timeliness, and completeness.
- Ensure all requirements are met while maintaining a sharp focus on differentiation and client impact.
- Oversee the creation of integrated deliverables (proposals, presentations, personas, videos, etc.) that reinforce the win strategy.

20% Cross-Functional Leadership & Accountability
- Act as the single point of accountability across Marketing and enterprise stakeholders for all RFP activities.
- Align 10–50+ contributors to clear roles, deadlines, and deliverables—holding teams accountable to commitments.
- Facilitate working sessions that drive decisions, resolve blockers, and maintain momentum toward submission.
- Capture and communicate clear actions, decisions, and ownership, ensuring follow-through and execution discipline.
- Proactively influence senior stakeholders to maintain focus on priorities and deliver high-quality inputs on time.

10% Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
- Own and evolve the RFP management process, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and consistency across submissions.
- Drive adoption of proposal management tools and best practices to improve speed, quality, and collaboration.
- Identify and implement improvements based on performance insights (e.g., cycle time, win rates, stakeholder feedback).
- Establish and track KPIs to measure proposal effectiveness and inform ongoing optimization.

10 % Stakeholder & Relationship Management (20%)
- Build strong, trusted relationships across functions to enable effective collaboration and high-quality contributions.
- Act as a strategic partner to stakeholders—anticipating needs, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment.
- Represent Marketing with credibility and clarity, ensuring a consistent and professional engagement model.
- Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous feedback across teams.

Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge
- Three to five (3-5) years of experience managing complex, multi-pronged projects with 10-50 stakeholders
- Extremely organized with an instinct for thinking on one’s feet and finding solutions on the fly
- Comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and collaborating with the multiple people and personalities behind the work
- Comfortable and confident enough to communicate with senior colleagues on a daily basis, helping them focus as needed, and facilitating the timely delivery of their deliverables
- Interest in growing into a role in project management and/or organizational dynamics, with a passion for finding efficiencies in the way teams operate on a day-to-day basis
- Interest in marketing, business strategy and/or persuasive writing also helpful

At Assurant, we celebrate the differences that make us who we are. jobs.title: Senior Data & Reporting Analyst, Finance (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Overview of Position
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data & Reporting Analyst to build, automate, and maintain data and business intelligence solutions for the Renters Insurance Financial Planning & Analysis team. This role serves as the primary technical owner of reporting and analytical solutions, translating FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into scalable technical solutions through data acquisition, validation, modeling, reporting, automation, and analysis.
Approximately 70-80% of the role focuses on data, reporting, business intelligence, analytics, and technical solution development, while the remaining portion is dedicated to understanding financial and business context. This position offers significant autonomy and ownership, allowing the analyst to influence decision-making, enhance reporting capabilities, drive automation initiatives, and explore the application of AI and emerging technologies within Finance.

What makes us different?
- Significant autonomy and ownership of reporting and analytical solutions from end to end.
- Opportunity to directly influence how data is leveraged for business and financial decision-making.
- Empowerment to recommend new analyses, process improvements, and scalable reporting solutions.
- Exposure to innovative technologies, including AI-driven solutions within Finance.
- Collaborative environment partnering with Finance, technology teams, and business stakeholders.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
- Translate FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into technical solutions that support actuals, budgets, forecasts, revenue, expenses, profitability, operational metrics, and KPIs.
- Explore, understand, and maintain knowledge of databases, data warehouses, reporting environments, business rules, and data dependencies.
- Assess data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and fitness for purpose.
- Extract, combine, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources.
- Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and maintain recurring reporting solutions and ad hoc analytical tools.
- Design, build, enhance, and support Power BI dashboards, data models, measures, and reporting solutions.
- Explore and integrate AI solutions into reporting and analytics development processes.
- Recommend reporting enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and scalable solutions.
- Document data sources, calculations, assumptions, controls, lineage, and operating procedures.
- Partner with data owners and technology teams while maintaining ownership of FP&A reporting and analytics deliverables.

What are the requirements needed for this position?
- 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting development, and analytics.
- Advanced SQL experience in a professional environment.
- Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including report development and data modeling.
- Advanced Excel skills for analysis, validation, financial modeling, and reporting.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal.
- Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
- Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?
- Experience with DAX, Power Query, testing, deployment, performance optimization, and production support within Power BI.
- Experience with Alteryx, Python, or similar tools for data preparation, integration, automation, and analysis.
- Exposure to financial planning systems, ERP platforms, general ledger data, or transaction-level data.
- Experience automating recurring reporting and analytical workflows.
- Experience supporting FP&A, Finance, Accounting, Commercial Analytics, Operations Analytics, or other data-driven business functions.
- Ability to interpret results, identify opportunities for deeper analysis, and recommend practical process improvements.
- Experience in insurance, financial services, or another data-intensive industry.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?
General office demands.

How much should I expect to travel?
No regular travel is expected for this position.

jobs.title: Repair Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Repair Operations Manager leads device processing operations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is accountable for production performance, quality standards, workforce development, and operational efficiency. You’ll oversee supervisors and technical teams to ensure production goals and customer SLAs are consistently met.

This is an onsite role in our Mt Juliet TN facility.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?
- Lead and supervise supervisors and production staff to execute device processing in line with company standards and work instructions
- Drive production performance, ensuring quality, throughput, and SLA targets are met
- Monitor workflows, enforce quality controls, and implement reporting systems to track KPIs
- Partner with leadership to set daily production plans, priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Optimize operations through line balancing, WIP reduction, and process improvements
- Coach, train, and develop team members; foster a positive, high-performance culture
- Implement and improve operational systems, procedures, and workforce planning
- Maintain a safe, compliant, and efficient work environment

What are the requirements needed for this position?
- 8+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, distribution, assembly, reverse logistics, or related operational environments
- 5+ years of experience leading supervisors and managing frontline operations teams
- Proven experience implementing Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies
- Demonstrated ability to analyze operational data and make informed, data-driven decisions
- Experience managing an hourly workforce in a fast-paced production environment
- Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills
- Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business reporting tools
- Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering results in a dynamic environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field
- Experience in wireless device repair, electronics manufacturing, OEM operations, or mobile device processing
- Knowledge of ISO 9001, R2, or similar quality certifications
- Familiarity with repair technologies, barcode scanning systems, and production tracking tools
- 10+ years of operations or production leadership experience
